correctness.rationale: Every outside subgroup is K(H,a) with H≤A and a+H∈A/H. Its covers above are in bijection with covers of A; a full saturated chain has precisely one index-two transition H<K(H,a). Forgetting the transition yields a complete flag of A, and its nondecreasing prime indices must be the ordered concatenation of Sylow flags counted by F(A). If e=v2(|A|), the transition can be inserted after j=0..e two-primary steps and has |A|/2^j coset choices, giving F(A)(2|A|-|A_odd|). The unrestricted-chain formula factors at H into b(H)|A:H|b(A/H); for odd squarefree C_n chains with initial crossing yield T≥n k!, while I=n. Independent full subgroup-lattice chain enumeration confirmed the monotone formula on eight cyclic, noncyclic and mixed kernels, notably C2², C2xC4, C3² and C2²xC3. The finite diagnostics do not replace the cover-bijection proof.
